request.style: English, male baritone, solo with gospel choir, acoustic guitar, upright bass, piano, drums, fiddle, warm and reverent, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I will thank the LORD with all my heart
I will tell of all your wonders
You are the Most High, the judge of earth
My enemies turn back and lose their grounders

[Pre-Chorus]

You have upheld my right in this place

[Chorus]
With all my heart I sing your praise
Rejoicing in the joy of your days
I will tell of all your wonders
With all my heart I stand

[Verse]

My cause is upheld in your light
My enemies are gone from sight

[Pre-Chorus]
They stumble and perish before your face

[Chorus]
With all my heart I sing your praise

[Chorus]
